notes.title: Customize Your Zombies with Stable Diffusion Technology in Survival Games
notes.content:
In recent days, a groundbreaking innovation called "Stable Diffusion" has become the talk of the town in the world of zombie survival games. This technology allows players to generate customized zombies according to their preferences, adding a new level of fun and challenge to the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43185407/50b97c6a0fc17c4d182024e5bfa972ccdda076da.png[/img]
Stable Diffusion technology is an AI-based algorithm that generates unique zombie appearances and characteristics by combining player-defined parameters and in-game mechanics. Players can personalize the zombies' appearance, behavior, and abilities based on their preferences and gameplay strategies.

The introduction of this technology has garnered enthusiastic responses from zombie game enthusiasts. Players are sharing their creatively designed zombies and actively participating in competitions and challenges to showcase their imaginationand skills. Some players have created highly mechanized zombies with extraordinary strength and speed, while others have opted for deceptive and cunning zombies to trap fellow players.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43185407/534a6fd663bfa0d92d8678e03a613914c8f3377c.png[/img]
Stable Diffusion technology not only enhances the personalization aspect of the game but also adds a new level of challenge. Players need to adapt their strategies and tactics based on the unique characteristics and abilities of each customized zombie to survive in a world infested with the undead. This has fostered cooperation and competition among players, resulting in a more diverse and engaging gaming experience.

Currently, Stable Diffusion technology has been successfully implemented in various zombie survival games, receiving positive feedback from players. They express their delight in being able to tailor the zombies to their liking, which enhances the enjoyment and thrill of the game. Game developers are continuously improving the technology, expanding its application to further enrich the possibilities of Stable Diffusion.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43185407/50b97c6a0fc17c4d182024e5bfa972ccdda076da.png[/img]
With Stable Diffusion technology, players can now unleash their creativity and imagination, designing zombies that suit their gameplay style. This innovative feature brings a fresh and dynamic element to the zombie survival genre, ensuring that no two gaming experiences are alike. Get ready to face an army of unique and customized zombies as you navigate the treacherous world of survival games.

notes.title: New Missions, Scenery, and Enhanced Server Performance!
notes.content:
Greetings, dear players!
We are thrilled to announce that our latest game update is now live! This update introduces new missions, stunning scenery, and an improved server performance for a smoother gaming experience. Here's a brief overview of what you can expect:
New Missions:
Embark on five brand new missions that will test your skills and strategy.
Encounter a variety of challenging enemies, and uncover the hidden secrets of the mysterious land.
Complete the missions to unlock exclusive in-game rewards and achievements.
New Scenery:
Explore three new breathtaking environments: The Frozen Tundra, The Lush Rainforest, and The Sunken City.
Each environment is meticulously crafted with stunning visuals and immersive sound effects.
Discover hidden easter eggs and unique interactions in each of the new areas.
Server Improvements:
Optimized server performance for smoother gameplay and reduced latency.
Enhanced matchmaking system to ensure a more balanced and enjoyable multiplayer experience.
Implemented server-side fixes to address known bugs and issues reported by players.
We appreciate your continuous support and feedback, which helps us make the game better and more enjoyable. We hope you'll love the new content and improvements in this update. Happy gaming!

notes.title: New Voice Engine and Building Mode
notes.content:
By accessing the most advanced neural network voice engine of Microsoft Azure, all voice in the game has been updated.
A new construction mode has been added. After the novice task is completed, he can choose the construction mode to obtain almost unlimited all materials and gain the ability to control the day and night. However, he will also lose the leaderboard function and cannot enter the player camp in story mode.

notes.title: Evaluation card for reviewer and connoisseur
notes.content:
This version is intended for players, professional reviewers, and connoisseurs to evaluate cards, which can be used to quickly upgrade, obtain rare items, sufficient power, camp security level, and alliance reputation.

The specific rules are as follows:
The evaluation card starting with 88 will get:
Experience value: 100 million
Money: 1 million
Power: 100000 kWh
Items: 100 each
Access methods include community, email, etc

It can be activated by dialing the evaluation card number from the mobile phone in the game.
In addition, there are evaluation cards starting at 87, 86, 85 and 84, each with sincere gifts.

But please note:
 [b] The account using the evaluation card can no longer join the camp [/b]
